title: crotalaria uncinella subsp. elliptica
intro: Crotalaria uncinella subsp. elliptica, commonly known as a species of flowering plant in the legume family, is a type of shrub native to tropical Africa. This plant is known to possess various health benefits, including its use in traditional medicine to treat fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Crotalaria uncinella subsp. elliptica are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
